data.name: Heart of the Mountains
data.description: Humans born in the mountains are skilled at negotiating heights and precipices. They gain a +2 racial bonus on Climb checks and Acrobatics checks to move on narrow surfaces and uneven ground. Furthermore, they are considered acclimated to the effects of high altitude (Core Rulebook 430). This racial trait replaces skilled.
